body:
## Summary
- Rebuild the main dashboard with a featured hero, category chips, horizontal rails, and tall cover cards inspired by CrazyGames.
- Give every game its own cover art and short blurb; hover shows a Play affordance.
- Point `bun start:docker` at the bind-mounted hot-reload stack (polling API watch + Vite HMR) and keep the baked image under `start:docker:baked`.

## Test plan
- [ ] `bun start`, open http://localhost:5173/, confirm hero, category filters, rails, and all-games grid
- [ ] Click a cover into `/play/:id` and return via lobby
- [ ] Filter by Classics / Gravity / Strategy and confirm the grid updates
- [ ] Optional: `bun start:docker` and confirm UI is on :5173 with live edits


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: Redesign the lobby as a CrazyGames-style game portal
